notes.title: Perfect Universe - White On Black Inverted Colours and Launching On PlayStation 4
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Perfect Universe has been out for a few months and we have seen quite a few of you aggressively compete for the the fastest times on the leader board! Congratulations to those that have topped the board against our testers and the developer Will Sykes.

As some of you may know, you can actually invert the colours for a white on black effect. We've inverted one of our trailers to show you what the game should look like when selecting this option. Check it out below:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=czqyGZyJgWI

Finally, we launched the console version of Perfect Universe on PlayStation 4. If you've not picked it up on PC you can purchase the game in on the PlayStation store for Europe and North America right now!

notes.title: Perfect Universe Launches On Steam - Initial Reviews
notes.content:
Hi everyone! 

Perfect Universe launches on Steam today with a special 25% launch discount.

We have had some pre-release reviews go live over the past couple of days and here are just a few that we've spotted.

Final Boss Fight:
http://finalbossfight.co.uk/editorial/preview-perfect-universe/

Gone With The Win:
http://gonewiththewin.com/just-chillin-with-a-perfect-universe-review/

Rock Paper Shotgun also previewed the game over at:
https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/2016/02/15/perfect-universe/

More reviews and let's plays are bound to go live within the next few days and we welcome all new players to Perfect Universe

notes.title: One Week Until Launch - Price
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

We are just one week away from launch of Perfect Universe! Over the last couple of weeks we have been sending out special cards that include the final release build of Perfect Universe.

[img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/CasiuKjXEAA31cK.jpg[/img]

Over the next week we should hope to see some new reviews and let's plays from journalists and YouTubers.

Perfect Universe will launch at $9.99 and will contain 9 playable game modes, some of which will feature local multiplayer and AI opponents.

notes.title: Gravity Check: The Mini Games Of Perfect Universe
notes.content:
A smidge of my weekend was spent trying out space gravity game Perfect Universe [official site]. A smidge more of my weekend was then spent trying not to get drawn into getting the full three stars on each of the levels so I could INSTEAD achieve three stars in the real life challenge that is Valentine’s Day weekend.

notes.title: Nine New Trailers!
notes.content:
Good day everyone!

We are pleased to share a batch of new trailers for Perfect Universe! We have in total nine different videos, each of which has annotations which allow you to click through and check the other game modes.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/m7NCEw8.jpg[/img]

We know that some players will definitely find a game mode they are most interested in and this is an excellent time to see just a little more info on each of the game modes.
